Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposed price basis and AS-14404 adjustment clause from 2027-01-01
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to review our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your team's consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize the cost pressures you described. We hope that prompt payment, a longer commitment and the proposed adjustment mechanism provide a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. If a 24-month commitment would suit your team better, we would be pleased to discuss that as well.

Thank you again for considering the package. Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We thank you for your constructive proposal and are pleased to accept the 36-month contract, 14-day payment terms, and the AS-14404 index. However, in recognition of our long-term partnership and the improved terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.40 per kg.

For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

To summarize, our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – revised proposal on the agreed structure
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you very much for your prompt review, and for accepting the 36-month term, 14-day payment and the AS-14404 clause. We appreciate this step and your willingness to build a longer arrangement with us.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.72/kg for part:370010 on the structure you approved: payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. All other terms stay unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01, with no tooling charges.

One point for your review: AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We fully recognize that the index remains higher than a year ago. Because the agreed clause will pass future movements on in both directions, we hope the starting price can reflect this more recent level.

Could you kindly let us know whether you can approve EUR 4.72/kg on this basis?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: part:370010 – revised proposal and a question on the cost baseline
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing our proposal again and for moving to EUR 5.20/kg. We appreciate the care your team has taken, and we understand that your annual input costs remain a real pressure.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.83/kg for part:370010 on the same structure? That means payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. All other terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01, with no tooling charges.

One question would help us understand your calculation. Our current price of EUR 5.84/kg has applied since 1 July 2026 as an index adjustment. Could you let us know which part of the annual increases you mentioned is already reflected in that July adjustment, and which part you see as still outstanding?

Thank you again for your partnership. Could you kindly let us know whether you can approve EUR 4.83/kg on this basis?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
